mathematics.assertion_tested: Reproduce the matrix-expanded semantic results and page output, including all declared finite matrix blocks and cutoff controls, Schur reconstruction, 605 reciprocal coefficients and 1012 local-chart outputs against the pinned source. Also compare every degree-12 Euler-to-Fibonacci matrix entry, polynomial companion powers 0..12, centered Euler recovery 0..12, and both full-index and compressed recurrence reconstructions through length 26 with pinned library APIs. Compare packet values/states and jump powers with the pinned arithmetic API and every calculus matrix entry with the pinned polynomial operator API. Compare quartic coefficients with the logarithmic analytic API, modular inverse/product with the Hurwitz API, all signed/second Stirling entries and formal log pullback/derivative/inverse/substitution with the pinned coordinate APIs.
mathematics.conventions: The primary EULER-CASE-006 contract applies. Full-index E_n and compressed E_(2n) are compared separately. Polynomial matrices act on finite-support coefficient columns.
inputs: Final worked page and standalone program
Pinned Komorebi Math source, N=2..6, n=0..10, integer powers 0..3 plus analytic parameters -2,-1,0,1/2,1,2,3
Prime charts 2,3,5,7 at every even degree 0..20, including source, kernel, inverse kernel, forward and inverse reconstruction, every finite truncation and row weight
Complete rows 0..11 of the nonzero infinite sampling-kernel witness, with their nonzero diagonal controls; exact base-change, supercongruence and congruential-family results
Euler-index supercongruence at primes 3,5,7, even starting degrees 2..12, shifted ordinary degree at most 54, with degree-zero counterexample at p=3

Pinned coordinates/polynomials.py and coordinates/recurrence.py: degree-12 connection entries, polynomial powers 0..12, centered Euler recovery 0..12, and full/compressed prefixes at every length 2..26

Packet values and two state coordinates for all N=1..12, every admitted address, and ten coarse terms; jump powers 1..12 plus 12*2^a for a=0..4; Fibonacci primitive and derivative matrices for source degrees 0..8
C_(4,j) values j=0..3,n=0..23; Hurwitz inverse and product degrees 0..24 at p=3,5,7; both Stirling tables and formal logarithmic coordinate outputs through degree 16
non_claims: No universal implementation proof or Lean execution.
External imported project-source hashes are recorded in the child result, with a Git source pin. Installed external dependencies are version-recorded, not bit-for-bit rebuilt.
No speedup or novelty is inferred.
